patronOf.en-US: Pope and Doctor of the Church

meta.face: A heavy-set, clean-shaven man of about sixty with a full, rounded face, a strong jaw, dark eyes and a calm, commanding yet kindly expression.
meta.basis: Raphael's Meeting of Leo the Great and Attila, chosen over the bearded Greek and Baroque types, which would repeat the white-bearded elder; no source records his features. Peter and Paul with swords are from the same scene. The excerpt is from his Christmas sermon.
